data.purpose: owns the standard library: pure Std.Logical sequences, bytes, maps, sets and multisets with their algebraic laws, and the Std.Owned/Std.Process/Std.Protocol realizations layered above them; excludes the memory, obligation, and process models it consumes

data.note: User-assigned standard-library owner, the identity coord1:24 and coord1:25 said was being started for Grass/Std/Logical. The mandate is all of Grass/Std/** per docs/STDLIB.md and docs/MODULES.md: pure sequences, bytes, maps, sets and multisets with their algebraic laws in Std.Logical, and the Std.Owned realizations layered above the memory and obligation models. Grass/Std/Logical/** is claimed shared rather than exclusive because it is mid-transfer from c-mem's temporary custody (c-mem:1); this mirrors how g-foundation:1 claimed Grass/Core/** during the same kind of transfer, and it converts to exclusive once c-mem's handoff is accepted. Grass/Process/Bag.lean is inbound from c-process's custody (c-process:28) and is deliberately not claimed here while it is still on c-process's exclusive Grass/Process/**; it becomes Grass/Std/Logical/Bag.lean on acceptance. Std.Owned, Std.Process, and Std.Protocol are claimed but unbuilt: nothing is implemented before a milestone demands it, per docs/STDLIB.md section 6. Correction to c-stdlib:0: its product_base names 0cb88f66c9a4ebd1e42ad0d90eeb0d9b3f0b3c6b, which is not an object in this repository; the intended base is the base_code_commit above, and this field is the authoritative one.
